label: P5A2-IABT-INTEGRATION
title: Integrate and jointly validate the branch-target IABT fence
dependency_override: T-007 is accepted_for_candidate by independent review and becomes done only after this candidate passes.
scope: Integrate the next-PC fetch outcome fence and durable maintenance response owner into a disposable candidate. Rebuild coordinators and rerun p5a plus the broad Round16 L0-L2 union because stall_wb and fetch ownership are global core control.

joint_validation.l0_l1: registry, compile, core/backpressure/FIFO base+cache/MMU/IRQ, maintenance-owner probe, FP/P7/muldiv SV+Cocotb union
joint_validation.l2: p5a; muldiv/rtl/hazard; pair/LSE/LSE128/maintenance/IRQ/STXR; NEON fetch fault; P7-1/3/4/5 matrices
joint_validation.negative: P7-2 fault BFM must fail at the registered assertion
joint_validation.resource: single local heavy queue, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0, CPU<=50%, VERILATOR_JOBS=1

acceptance: All registered joint tests pass on one exact candidate source SHA. Then feature/p7-final advances by ff-only. T-008 remains the pure Round16 physical report; a post-T007 physical rerun is required before choosing the next timing lane because the new settled comparators may affect sys_clk_50.

review.summary: Branch-IABT and maintenance owner corrections passed the exact T-013 L0-L2 union and fresh physical source binding.

board_policy: No assembler, JTAG programming, bitstream download, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
